caseScope: Known Infantry squad and a particular building Location; no SSR or unmodeled movement modifier unless explicitly stated by a case. A case is an input contract, not an inference from board state.

cases.declaredFacts: The nine true facts in the first-case decision, including known empty ground-level ordinary wooden or stone building, sufficient MF, normal stacking and no special modifier.
cases.reason: Only the previously accepted synthetic first case.

cases.declaredFacts: Known unconcealed armed enemy MMC in the same destination Location during MPh; ordinary Infantry movement; none of the A4.14 exceptions (Berserk, Human Wave, Disrupted, Unarmed, Infantry OVR, PRC or charging Cavalry) applies.
cases.reason: A4.14 bars ordinary MPh entry into the same Location with an unconcealed enemy; its listed exceptions are explicitly excluded.

cases.declaredFacts: Fortified target Location contains a known unpinned Good Order armed enemy squad; entry hexside and level are unbreached; no A4.14 exception or special scenario modifier.
cases.reason: B23.922 bars entry under these facts; its breach exception B23.9221 is absent. The known enemy independently triggers A4.14 during MPh.

cases.declaredFacts: Target has a concealed or hidden occupant whose identity is not yet established; no defender reveal, Dummy determination or overrun election is supplied.
cases.reason: A12.15 describes detection and forced-back consequences; the required reveal and any follow-on exception cannot be inferred before resolution.

cases.declaredFacts: One known enemy SMC, with NTC, cost, defensive response and immediate CC not fully modeled.
cases.reason: A4.15 permits an exceptional attempt subject to its test and follow-on branches; a bare eligibility label would overstate the result.

cases.declaredFacts: A breach is asserted but its creation, exact crossed hexside, level and remaining entry restrictions are not verified as one path.
cases.reason: B23.9221 refers to B23.711; the latter is located in the registered source but is not part of the delegated verified subject set.

cases.declaredFacts: Destination is not empty and its squad-equivalent count must be calculated rather than declared below limit.
cases.reason: A5.5 classification and the resulting stacking calculation have not been verified for this broader case.

cases.declaredFacts: Attempt occurs in APh, outside the reviewed MPh movement and cost facts.
cases.reason: A4.14 distinguishes APh, but the APh action and its applicable restrictions are outside the reviewed MPh case.

cases.declaredFacts: Location identity, occupancy or scenario modifier is unknown or contradictory.
cases.reason: No definitive ruling can inherit the declared case when a controlling fact is unknown.
